name: Vampiric Vitality
body:
Your malice robs the dying of their vitality.

Prerequisite(s): Caster Level 9th, Any of the following; Death Domain, Curse of Death, Curse of Violence, Death Patron, Reaper Mystery.

Benefit: Whenever an enemy within 10 ft. of you takes damage that leaves it with 0 or fewer hit points it must make a Fortitude save equal to 10 + your class level + your Charisma modifier or be instantly slain. Whenever a creature with at least half as many hit dice as you dies within this aura you regain 1d8 hit points plus your Charisma modifier.
